title: calibration_profile.yaml (v1)
description: Phase 13.2 — Calibration profile YAML per docs/design/COMPETITIONS.md §4. Loaded at boot by CalibrationProfileLoader; validates profile_id uniqueness, required fields, and numeric ranges.

profile_id.description: Unique profile identifier used by Competition.calibration_profile_id and CompetitionStage.calibration_profile_id overrides. Filename MUST match this value.

description.description: Human-readable description of when/why this profile is used.

elo_home_advantage_mult.description: Multiplicative overlay on LeagueConfig.elo_home_advantage (e.g. 0.5 for cup neutral venues). Default 1.0 if absent.

dixon_coles_rho_add.description: Additive adjustment to Dixon-Coles rho (low-scoring inflation). Default 0.0 if absent.

draw_sample_weight_mult.description: Multiplicative overlay on draw sample weight (e.g. 0.7 for KO draws being artifacts). Default 1.0 if absent.

poisson_max_goals_add.description: Additive adjustment to max goals in tail distribution. Default 0.0 if absent.

xg_elo_factor_range_mult.description: Multiplicative variance scale for xG-Elo interaction. Default 1.0 if absent.

upset_prior.description: Additive prior on the underdog column of 1X2 predictions. Default 0.0 if absent.

zero_home_advantage_when_venue_in.description: List of venue_policy values that force home_advantage to zero regardless of elo_home_advantage_mult. Typical: ["neutral", "bubble"].

two_leg.description: Optional section: tie-aggregation rules for two_leg_knockout format.

away_goals_rule_active_until.description: ISO-8601 date after which away-goals rule is no longer active (e.g., '2021-05-31' for pre-2021/22 UCL). Null for competitions where rule is perpetually active.

aggregate_logic.description: How goals are aggregated (currently only 'sum_goals' supported).

penalty_shootout_modeled.description: Whether penalties are explicitly modeled vs skipped. Default true.
